title: You Can Acquire the Habit of Happiness
coreMove: Happiness becomes usable when you practice cheerful, tolerant, calm conduct for 21 days while acting on real problems and refusing useless pessimistic coloring.

exampleSpecs.audience: Preston, a supervisor trying to keep one bad morning from defining the crew
exampleSpecs.stakes: A missed shipment can turn into a full-day emotional climate if the leader lets the first mood rule.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use King Solomon and Proverbs to frame cheerfulness as functional medicine, not decoration.

exampleSpecs.audience: Daniel, a reader who doubts emotional habits can be altered
exampleSpecs.stakes: If the cue is skipped, the day starts inside the old self-image before Daniel notices.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show the 21-day shoe-first exercise as proof that automatic conduct can be interrupted.

exampleSpecs.audience: Sabrina, a receptionist facing complaints without wanting to fake happiness
exampleSpecs.stakes: A stressful desk can train irritability unless the daily instructions become visible conduct.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the eight daily instructions as specific behavior, including smiling three times and calm reaction.

exampleSpecs.domain: teacher grading after a difficult class
exampleSpecs.audience: Noel, a teacher tempted to let a rough class color the rest of the day
exampleSpecs.stakes: If one class becomes a total verdict, Noel will carry irritation into students who did nothing wrong.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use pessimistic facts, calm reaction, and success expectation to separate useful correction from mood coloring.

exampleSpecs.audience: Charles, a tenant preparing for a tense hearing
exampleSpecs.stakes: An anxious morning could make Charles brittle before he has to speak clearly.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the merry heart as medicine frame while preserving the need to face a real problem.

exampleSpecs.audience: Melanie, a caregiver who misses the habit cue but can still recover the day
exampleSpecs.stakes: One missed cue could become proof of failure unless the exercise is treated as practice, not perfection.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show the 21-day exercise as repeated practice, including left shoe, right shoe, and morning cue.
